townhall.name: Town hall
townhall.desc: Heart of a city. Houses 10, accepts every good, and civilians shelter here when zombies come. Lose the capital's and the run ends.
townhall.label: TH

camp.name: Camp
camp.desc: An outpost of its city. Lets you build within 30 tiles of it and accepts every good.
camp.label: Cp

house.name: House
house.desc: Homes for 6 civilians. Cities only grow with free housing and a food surplus.
house.label: H

farm.name: Farm
farm.desc: Grows food on open grassland. The backbone of every city.
farm.label: F

fishery.name: Fishery
fishery.desc: Catches food from an adjacent river or ford.
fishery.label: Fi

hunter.name: Hunter's lodge
hunter.desc: Hunts food in the forest. Low yield, but works where farms can't.
hunter.label: Hu

granary.name: Granary
granary.desc: Drop-off point for food, so farmers walk less.
granary.label: Gr

woodcutter.name: Woodcutter
woodcutter.desc: Fells nearby forest for wood. Richer forest, faster work.
woodcutter.label: W

quarry.name: Quarry
quarry.desc: Cuts stone from a nearby stone deposit.
quarry.label: Q

mine.name: Mine
mine.desc: Digs ore from a nearby ore deposit.
mine.label: M

coalpit.name: Coal pit
coalpit.desc: Digs fuel from a nearby coal deposit.
coalpit.label: C

stockpile.name: Stockpile
stockpile.desc: Drop-off point for wood, stone, ore, fuel and iron.
stockpile.label: St

charcoal.name: Charcoal burner
charcoal.desc: Burns wood into fuel anywhere. Inefficient, but no deposit needed.
charcoal.label: Ch

smelter.name: Smelter
smelter.desc: Smelts ore with fuel into iron.
smelter.label: Sm

library.name: Library
library.desc: Scholars produce research points for new technology.
library.label: L

fletcher.name: Fletcher
fletcher.desc: Turns wood into bows for archers.
fletcher.label: Fl

poleturner.name: Poleturner
poleturner.desc: Turns wood and iron into spears.
poleturner.label: Po

blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
blacksmith.desc: Forges swords from iron and fuel.
blacksmith.label: Bs

armory.name: Armory
armory.desc: Drop-off point for weapons and horses.
armory.label: Ar

stable.name: Stable
stable.desc: Raises horses from food for cavalry and scouts.
stable.label: Sb

barracks.name: Barracks
barracks.desc: Trains soldiers from civilians plus equipment from the armory stock.
barracks.label: Ba

cartdepot.name: Cart depot
cartdepot.desc: Builds carts that haul goods between cities along your routes.
cartdepot.label: CD

wall.name: Wood wall
wall.desc: Blocks humans and zombies. Zombies must hack through it.

swall.name: Stone wall
swall.desc: Four times the strength of a wooden wall.

gate.name: Wood gate
gate.desc: Your people pass; zombies are blocked and must break it.
gate.label: G

sgate.name: Stone gate
sgate.desc: A gate with the strength of stone.
sgate.label: G

tower.name: Wood tower
tower.desc: Garrisons up to 5 archers with +3 range, safe from the horde.
tower.label: T

lookout.name: Lookout tower
lookout.desc: A tall unmanned watchtower that reveals a wide area. No crew, no weapons — it only opens up the view.
lookout.label: Lo

stower.name: Stone tower
stower.desc: A much tougher tower for up to 5 archers.
stower.label: T

trap.name: Spike trap
trap.desc: Damages every zombie that crosses it. Wears out.

ditch.name: Ditch
ditch.desc: Slows zombies by half. Costs only labor.

catapult.name: Catapult
catapult.desc: Hurls stones for area damage at range 5–20. Needs a crew of 2.
catapult.label: Ca

ballista.name: Ballista
ballista.desc: Fires bolts that pierce every zombie in a line. Needs a crew of 2.
ballista.label: Bl

nest.name: Zombie nest
nest.desc: Spawns the dead. Destroy all four to win.
nest.label: N
